question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle ownership and its Doctor diagnostics be a core OpenClaw capability before the stacked Claws feature line is merged?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and gated, but it establishes new core lifecycle/state and Doctor ownership rather than repairing an established public behavior; that product boundary cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Pause for explicit core sponsorship
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until an owner confirms the RFC-backed Claws lifecycle model belongs in core and its stack order is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed core experiment
options.body: Approve a deliberately narrow, clearly gated diagnostic surface after the prerequisite lands and exact-head runtime proof is refreshed.

options.title: Move the capability outward
options.body: Decline core ownership and pursue lifecycle diagnostics through an external plugin or ClawHub package if current extension seams prove sufficient.

recommendation.title: Pause for explicit core sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until an owner confirms the RFC-backed Claws lifecycle model belongs in core and its stack order is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing signal in the provided timeline for this maintainer-labeled experimental stack.
